description: Prefer this to deleting an entity and re-creating it under another name: rename existing entities and/or change their entity type, keeping their observations and relations. A rename onto a name that already exists is refused rather than merging the two; an unknown name is reported and the batch keeps its other entries.

entities.description: One entry per entity: the current name, and the new name and/or type

entityType.description: The new entity type; omit to keep the current type

name.description: The current name of the entity to update

newName.description: The new name to rename the entity to; omit to keep the current name

name: update_entities
title: Update Entities
